sections.title: Before reading: study Chapter11 in How to read. I. A last sighting must be earned

segments.text: 客步至川，立。客在西岸，無書，無紙。客視路，視川。日出，岸明；客步至岸，視路，乃止。
師在彼屋，視卷。卷在架上，葉濕。寧持大書，紙在帙中。門外有雨，安視門。
師告安，安視師。
師：「汝尋客。汝行吾言，吾問客。」
segments.speaker: char-teacher

segments.text: 安：「先生，吾尋客。客去。吾不知主。」
segments.speaker: char-an

segments.text: 師：「吾信汝言。汝尋客，吾問客。」
segments.speaker: char-teacher

segments.text: 師指書，寧視帙。
師：「請視書。」
segments.speaker: char-teacher

segments.text: 寧：「諾。吾持書，先生視書。」
segments.speaker: char-ning

segments.text: 寧先視帙，開帙，持書。師視書，視紙。書乾，紙乾。寧開書，師視破葉。破葉有半字，紙有姓。師不讀姓，寧閉書，閉帙。卷濕，師不取書。
師返，至架前，視卷。寧持此書，安視彼卷。安不取卷，師不移卷。人持燈，在此屋。
寧：「吾敢問：誰負此書？」
segments.speaker: char-ning

segments.text: 師：「寧，汝負此書，隨安。書在帙中，紙在帙中。汝不獨行。」
segments.speaker: char-teacher

segments.text: 師：「吾在此屋，視卷。安、寧返至此屋。吾問客，吾不取此書。」
segments.speaker: char-teacher

segments.text: 寧視安，安至彼門，過門，至此屋。人持帙，帙濕。安視印，人視安。燈在手，安無燈。
安開門，出門，閉門。安乃奔至路，視川。此路近，川在東。安步至西岸，見客。

sections.title: II. An returns with evidence; Ning prepares the load

segments.text: 安行此言，尋客。客在西岸，步至路。安呼客，客步。安至岸，客去；安不見客，乃返。
安速返，奔至門前，呼人。人持燈，至門後，開門。安入門，人閉門。人不出門，安過彼門。
師在架前，寧持書。安告先生，師視安。
安：「吾見客。客在西岸。吾呼客，客去。吾言真。」
segments.speaker: char-an

segments.text: 師：「吾信汝言。客去，吾不見客。安，汝追客。」
segments.speaker: char-teacher

segments.text: 安：「先生，吾追客。寧持大書，吾無書。吾速至川，寧步。」
segments.speaker: char-an

segments.text: 師視寧，寧視安。
師：「寧，汝隨安。」
segments.speaker: char-teacher

segments.text: 寧：「吾負書，隨安。」
segments.speaker: char-ning

segments.text: 師指安，乃指寧。安無書，寧負大書。師不隨安，返至架前。卷在架上，師視卷。
寧閉帙，負大書，持帙。書在帙中，紙在帙中。寧步至彼門，過門，至此屋。安隨寧，至門後。
人視書，視帙。寧持此帙，人持彼帙。此帙乾，彼帙濕。兩帙異，印在彼帙上。安先視印，乃視書。
寧：「是帙乾，書乾。此書有破葉，彼卷在架上。吾別此書、彼卷。」
segments.speaker: char-ning

segments.text: 人持燈，安開門。寧視門外，見雨。寧負書，持帙，不奔。安至門前，待寧。寧步出門，安出門，人閉門。人持燈，持帙，返至彼門前。師視卷，人不去。
安乃奔至路，追客。寧負書，持帙，步至路。寧視安，安視川。安速至岸，寧隨安。

segments.text: 路有水。此路在北，彼路在南。安至此路，奔至西岸。寧至此路，視水，止。寧負書，持帙。

inference_aids.alt: Water on the northern path interrupts Ning while An continues to the west bank.
inference_aids.art_brief: At the west-side fork, Ning stops before water on the northern path, supporting her closed book case against her back with a handhold. An, without a load, has continued toward the west bank. The alternate path runs south toward the mountain’s near face. No strap, open case, dry contents claim, boat or crossing. Reader’s lamp is absent from both children.

segments.text: 寧視帙，帙下有水。紙在帙中，寧不開帙。寧不行此言，不隨安。寧移書，持帙，返至彼路。
寧：「吾隨安，路有水。吾負書，紙在帙中。吾不奔，吾步。」
segments.speaker: char-ning

segments.text: 寧步至彼路。山在南，路在山前。寧視南橋，橋遠；寧負書，步至山前。
安在西岸，追客。北橋近，橋在水中。安視橋，止。安不渡川，視路。安不見客，不見寧。
安：「吾追客，客在何處？寧在何處？」
segments.speaker: char-an

segments.text: 安返至路，呼寧。不聞聲。安步至兩路間，視此路，視彼路。此路近，彼路遠。安不見寧，乃返。
寧在山前，待安。帙濕，書在帙中。寧移書，持帙；書在手，寧不負書。寧不開帙，待安。
安：「吾不見寧。吾速返，告先生。」
segments.speaker: char-an

segments.text: 安速返，至門前。門閉，屋內有火。安在門外，無書，無紙。師在屋內，寧在山前。
寧持大書，紙在帙中。人持燈，帙有印。師視卷，卷濕。安呼人，門閉。

grammar.title: 負書，步；尋客，奔。
grammar.rule: 安｜開門，出門，閉門。寧｜閉帙，負大書，持帙。
grammar.note_en:
A subject is the person doing an action. In a serial action chain, several actions retain the same named subject. 安開門，出門，閉門 means “An opens the door, goes out and closes it” (s016). 寧閉帙，負大書，持帙 means “Ning closes the case, carries the large book on her back and keeps hold of the case” (s027). The handhold supports the closed case against her back; no strap is implied. A newly named subject changes the actor: 寧步出門，安出門，人閉門 means “Ning walks out, An goes out, and Reader closes the door” (s030). Track the named actor, rather than assuming every following action belongs to the first person.

安行此言，尋客 means “An carries out this instruction and seeks Guest” (s017). Teacher’s 汝行吾言 means “You, carry out my words” (s004); my refers to the quoted speaker. Ning’s 寧不行此言，不隨安 means “Ning does not carry out this instruction and does not follow An” (s033): water interrupts her attempt while she carries the borrowed material. These are the new act-on sense of 行, distinct from travel in 汝不獨行, “You do not travel alone” (s013). In s034 she recounts her preceding attempt: 吾隨安，路有水 means “I followed An; there was water on the path.” This quotation explains why her following stopped.

至 names reaching a destination: 安乃奔至路 means “Only then An runs to the path” (s016); 寧負書，持帙，步至路 means “Ning back-carries the book, holds the case and walks to the path” (s031). The named subject continues through the actions. 乃 marks an action after its stated prerequisite. 安不見客，乃返 means “An does not see Guest and only then returns” (s017). 速 qualifies an action: 安速返，奔至門前 means “An returns quickly and runs to the door” (s018). It does not describe a fast person.

The opening narrator shows Guest outside; indoor characters do not thereby know his route. An’s later report concerns his last sighting. The borrowed large book, its closed case and enclosed surname sheet remain with Ning. Reader keeps the lamp and separate wet marked wrapper. Teacher attends the wet fascicle on the dry-room shelf. The exterior rain-door differs from the connecting doorway. Both paths remain on the west side of the river; the return base is the near refuge.

The repeated actor in the evidence is material to interpret, not a cue that identifies the answer by itself. C.title: Pensum C — Knowledge, instructions and the separated paths
C.instruction:
For each numbered scene task, write Chinese scene evidence using the supplied cue. Give an open response in your own Chinese sentence or sequence, then compare with the model and English rubric. Explain no abstract grammatical terms in Chinese; the English rubric supplies those interpretation checks.
1. Show Guest’s outward movement and Teacher’s indoor position.
2. Show Teacher’s two instructions, the inspection request and assent, the opening and closure, and Ning’s supported load.
3. Show An’s outward door cycle, return door cycle and connecting passage, and quote his last-sighting report.
4. Show An and Ning’s different movement and who keeps the lamp, wrapper and wet fascicle.
5. Show the water, Ning’s interrupted following and her southern route.
6. Show An’s return base and uncertainty, contrasted with Ning’s location and custody.

model_answers: 客步至川，立。客在西岸。師在屋內，視卷。
items.rubric: The narrator shows Guest at the familiar west bank; no indoor character thereby knows his route. Guest has no book or sheet. Nothing proves escape, theft, clasp damage or ultimate ownership.

model_answers: 師：「汝尋客。汝行吾言。」師：「請視書。」寧：「諾。」寧開帙，開書。師視破葉。寧閉書，閉帙。師：「寧，汝負此書，隨安。」寧負大書，持帙。書在帙中，紙在帙中。
items.rubric: Identified instructions, not a moral maxim, motivate actions. The case remains in Ning’s handhold while carried against her back. Before leaving she opens for the permitted inspection and recloses it; closure offers temporary protection, not waterproofing.

model_answers: 安開門，出門，閉門。安見客，客在西岸。安返，至門前。人開門，安入門，人閉門。安過彼門。安告先生。安：「吾見客。客在西岸。吾呼客，客去。」
items.rubric: An has an actual sighting and later reports it. His last-seen position is not guaranteed to remain current. He crosses the connecting doorway on return; neither Reader nor Teacher is a river eyewitness.

model_answers: 安奔，寧負書，持帙，步。書在帙中，紙在帙中。人持燈，持帙。師視卷，卷濕。
items.rubric: An is unladen; Ning retains a handhold on the back-carried assembly and walks. Reader keeps lamp/wet marked wrapper in the original room; Teacher attends the opened wet fascicle on the dry shelf. All exterior openings and closures are explicit.

model_answers: 寧視水，止。寧不行此言，不隨安。安在西岸，寧步至彼路。山在南，路在山前。
items.rubric: The wet route and borrowed material make following fail; this is not an accusation of wilful misconduct. Negative行 is act-on-words, not travel. Ning uses the southern branch and does not cross the river. An cannot know her unseen route merely because the narrator shows it.

model_answers: 安不見寧，乃返。安速返，至門前。安在門外。寧在山前，持大書。紙在帙中。人持燈，師視卷。
items.rubric: An returns toward the near refuge where Teacher told them to return, not the far family home. His arrival without Ning sets up12. Ning still has the authorized loaned assembly; no boat, new owner or lost family object is invented.
